errors.text_span: in absteigender Reihenfolge nach der Gesamthöhe ihrer Verteidigungsausgaben im Jahr 2021
errors.evidence: The description states that the countries are sorted in descending order of their total defense expenditures in 2021. This is incorrect. The sorting is by the total projected spending for 2024 (the full length of the stacked bar). For example, Lithuania (ranked 4th) has lower 2021 spending (green bar, approx. 1.8%) than Finland (ranked 5th, green bar approx. 2.1%), but a higher total projected spending for 2024.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nicht nach dem Anstieg, sondern nach der Gesamthöhe der Ausgaben 2021 sortiert
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of the previous error, stating that the bars are sorted by the 2021 expenditures. The chart shows the sorting is based on the total bar length, which represents the projected expenditures for 2024.
